ideas.title: The Impact of Welfare Fraud on Minnesota's Most Vulnerable Populations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the impact of welfare fraud on Minnesota's most vulnerable populations, including low-income families and individuals with disabilities.
ideas.angle: The human impact of welfare fraud
questions: How has welfare fraud affected low-income families in Minnesota?
What are the long-term consequences of welfare fraud for individuals and communities?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it highlights the human impact of welfare fraud and the need for effective solutions to prevent and address this issue.

ideas.title: The Role of Government Agencies in Preventing Welfare Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the role of government agencies in preventing welfare fraud, including the Minnesota Department of Human Services and the Trump administration.
ideas.angle: The role of government agencies in preventing welfare fraud
questions: What steps have government agencies taken to prevent welfare fraud?
How effective have these efforts been in reducing fraud and misuse of funds?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it highlights the importance of effective oversight and management of welfare programs to prevent fraud and misuse of funds.
